Name: Benaiah the Pirathonite
Summary: Benaiah the Pirathonite was among David's thirty mighty men. He is distinct from Benaiah son of Jehoiada, captain of the guard.
KeyStory: Benaiah the Pirathonite stood among David's thirty.
LifeLesson: Two Benaiahs served David — a captain and a thirty-man — and both were valiant.
